description: This file is a CMake script for configuring and building the AOTriton library, including downloading prebuilt binaries, building dependencies on Windows, and managing different versions and images for ROCm and Linux platforms.

methods.name: aotriton_build_windows_dependencies
methods.description: Builds Windows-specific dependencies such as dlfcn-win32 and xz/liblzma.

methods.name: aotriton_build_from_source
methods.description: Builds the AOTriton library from source, including dependencies, on Windows or when prebuilt binaries are unavailable.

methods.name: aotriton_download_runtime
methods.description: Downloads pre-compiled AOTriton runtime binaries for specific ROCm and Linux versions.

methods.name: aotriton_download_image
methods.description: Downloads specific GPU images for AOTriton.
